compose_config_error_git_bind_mount.description: Git源使用相对bind mount（Compose配置错误）

v2_response.error: Relative bind mount './data/redis' is not supported for Git-based builds. Git source files are checked out during the Jenkins build stage, not in the workspace snapshot. To include files in the container, use COPY instructions in your Dockerfile instead of bind mounts.

error_detail.summary: Relative bind mount './data/redis' is not supported for Git-based builds. Git source files are checked out during the Jenkins build stage, not in the workspace snapshot. To include files in your container, use COPY instructions in your Dockerfile instead of bind mounts.
error_detail.remediation: Replace bind mounts with Dockerfile COPY instructions. For configuration files: COPY config/ /app/config/. For data persistence: use named Docker volumes instead of bind mounts.

v1_response_legacy.error: Workspace mount source does not exist: ./data/redis; upload it before creating the build

v2.user_action: 修改Compose配置，使用Dockerfile COPY替代bind mount

v1.误导: 提示'upload it'让用户误以为需要上传workspace文件，但实际是配置问题
v1.user_action: 用户可能尝试上传文件（错误的方向）

client_integration_guide.description: APPS客户端如何集成新的错误分类

step1_check_code_field.description: 首先检查error_detail.code字段判断错误类型

step2_extract_details.description: 提取结构化字段用于展示

step3_backward_compatibility.description: 向后兼容：处理旧版本构建记录
step3_backward_compatibility.python_example:
def is_compose_config_error_safe(build):
    """兼容新旧版本的判断逻辑"""
    error_detail = build.get('error_detail')
    
    # 新版本：有error_detail.code字段
    if error_detail and 'code' in error_detail:
        return error_detail.get('code') == 'COMPOSE_CONFIG_ERROR'
    
    # 旧版本：无code字段，无法准确判断
    # 返回False，避免误判
    return False

deployment_notes.field_availability: 新字段（error_detail.code, subcode, remediation等）仅在部署后的新构建中出现
deployment_notes.database_compatibility: 新字段为可选，旧版本服务仍可读取构建记录
deployment_notes.api_compatibility: 旧字段（error, failure_site, recognized）继续填充，保持向后兼容
deployment_notes.rollback_impact: 回退后，Git源bind mount会重新出现误导性错误消息（'upload it before creating'）
deployment_notes.testing_strategy: 部署到预发布环境后，触发各类错误场景验证error_detail正确填充

response_fields.error: 用户可读的错误摘要（向后兼容）

create_build.sync_validation: 同步检查Compose配置，立即返回422如果有配置错误
create_build.async_validation: 复杂的验证（如Git源bind mount检查）在异步validating阶段执行
